findings.description: F-004: «хранить текущее состояние как значение enum.Enum (глава 13)» (build_chapter_20.py:1993-1996) cited the wrong chapter. Chapter 13 is «Функции» (def/return/scope); grep for 'enum' there returns only `enumerate(range(3, 9))` at line 2561. enum.Enum is introduced in chapter 18 (`from enum import Enum` / `class Tool(Enum)`) and reused in chapter 19 (Direction, GameStatus). The «глава 19» half of the same sentence is correct.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: «(глава 13)» -> «(глава 18)», leaving the correct «глава 19» reference untouched. Verified after rebuild: «enum.Enum (глава 13)» returns 0 files and «(глава 18)» appears once in 20-25-sostoyaniya-igry.html.

findings.description: F-020: the alt text for game-states-strip.png (build_chapter_20.py:2032) said «...тот же кадр с оверлеем ПАУЗА», but scene_sostoyaniya_igry() never blits the score line in the paused panel, so it is visibly not the same frame as the playing panel. The fourth panel also reads «GAME OVER — счёт: 140» against the second panel's «Счёт: 40», odd for four states of one session.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_20.py: the alt text now describes the paused panel as it actually renders (ball plus the yellow ПАУЗА overlay, no score line) rather than claiming «тот же кадр», and the caption now states outright that these are four separate snapshots rather than one continuous run, which explains why the scores do not follow on from each other.
